premises: Phase-selective recrystallization (PSR) can be achieved in Ni30Co30Cr10Fe10Al18W2 by annealing below the B2 recrystallization onset, recrystallizing only the FCC phase.
PSR produces a microstructure with equiaxed recrystallized FCC grains embedded in a skeletal, unrecrystallized B2 network.
This PSR microstructure enhances strain hardening by fully activating the ductile FCC phase while the B2 phase provides strength via load partitioning and microcrack arrest.
The PSR treatment yields a uniform elongation of ~35% and a true stress of ~2 GPa, surpassing a fully recrystallized baseline.
The concept is demonstrated in the specific eutectic HEA Ni30Co30Cr10Fe10Al18W2.
